basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) Junior Research Fellow (GATE) Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati). A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the IIT Guwahati Junior Research Fellow (GATE) Recruitment 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate degree in Water Resources Engg. / Atmospheric Science/ Energy/ Graduate Degree in any Professional Course selected through GATE or National Eligibility Test CSIRUGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship), The selection process through National Level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IISc, IISER etc.
qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow(GATE): Post Graduate degree in Water Resources Engg. / Atmospheric Science/ Energy/ Graduate Degree in any Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: 1. Scholars selected through GATE or National Eligibility Test CSIRUGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship). 2. how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Junior Research Fellow(GATE) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Guwahati JRF(GATE) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the IIT Guwahati JRF(GATE) Recruitment 2026 is 04 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for JRF(GATE) posts at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the JRF(GATE) post in the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati Recruitment 2026. This offers a specific opportunity for eligible candidates in the relevant fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIT Guwahati JRF(GATE) Recruitment?
faq.answer: According to the official notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Guwahati JRF(GATE) Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without any payment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the JRF(GATE) position at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: The salary for the JRF(GATE) position at IIT Guwahati ranges from Rs. 37000 to Rs. 42920 per month. This is a competitive salary package for a Junior Research Fellow role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for JRF(GATE) posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF(GATE) posts at IIT Guwahati primarily involves an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and then called for the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for the JRF(GATE) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate degree in Water Resources Engg. / Atmospheric Science/ Energy or a Graduate Degree in any Professional Course selected through GATE or National Eligibility Test (CSIR/UGC NET) or other national-level examinations.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the JRF(GATE) post be located?
faq.answer: The JRF(GATE) post will be located in Guwahati, Assam, specifically at the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati campus. This offers an opportunity to work in a premier educational institution.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website for IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official website for Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is https://iitg.ac.in. Candidates can visit this website for detailed information, notifications, and to apply online.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The JRF(GATE) position at IIT Guwahati under this recruitment is a Contractual job. It provides an opportunity for research experience within a defined project duration.

faq.question: Q10. When is the Online Interview scheduled for JRF(GATE) posts?
faq.answer: The Online Interview for the JRF(GATE) posts is scheduled for 06 August 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the specific time and platform for the interview.
